# `delivery-template` commands

## `delivery-template create`

Create an email template for a kind: a subject and a plain-text body. Merge fields are a closed list per kind (`delivery-template fields`), written {{customer.name}}; {{if document.po_number}}...{{end}} shows text only when the field has a value. An unknown field is refused, naming it. Example: {"kind": "invoice", "name": "Short", "subject": "Invoice {{document.number}}", "body": "Attached."}.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | standard |
| Capability | customer |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/delivery-template.create` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow delivery-template create --kind invoice --name Brief --subject "Invoice {{document.number}}" --body "Total {{document.total}}." --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --reason "A short one" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "delivery-template create", "input": {"kind": "invoice", "name": "Brief", "subject": "Invoice {{document.number}}", "body": "Total {{document.total}}."}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `--kind` | literal["invoice", "sales-receipt", "estimate", "statement", "notice"] | yes | no | — | — |
| `name` | `--name` | string | yes | no | — | minimum length 1; maximum length 100 |
| `subject` | `--subject` | string | yes | no | — | Subject with merge fields.; minimum length 1; maximum length 500 |
| `body` | `--body` | string | yes | no | — | Plain-text body with merge fields.; maximum length 20000 |
| `is_default` | `--is-default` | boolean | no | no | false | Make it the kind's default. |

## `delivery-template update`

Change a template's name, subject or body, or make it its kind's default (the old default stops being one).

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | standard |
| Capability | customer |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/delivery-template.update` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow delivery-template update Brief --kind invoice --is-default --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --reason "Use the short one" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json

```

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
